name: Olivia Dunne career
content: Olivia Dunne's career highlights: LSU gymnast 2021–2025; helped win LSU's first NCAA gymnastics championship in 2024; Sports Illustrated Swimsuit cover model; one of the highest-paid NIL athletes in college sports; Named by Forbes as one of the top creators; retired from gymnastics in April 2025

name: Olivia Dunne personal
content: About Olivia Dunne: Born October 1, 2002, in Westwood, New Jersey. Started gymnastics at age 3 because she climbed everything. Dating MLB pitcher Paul Skenes; 13M+ followers across social platforms.

name: Olivia Dunne quotes
content: Things Olivia Dunne has said: I really do feel like a different person than three years ago... I feel like my confidence has grown. I feel like I'm a woman now. | You are more than your sport.

name: Olivia Dunne voice
content: Olivia Dunne's speaking style: Candid and motivational, especially for young athletes. Confident in clapping back at critics, vulnerable about pressure and body image.
